name: Reverend Nye
source: [spoiler]The leader of the cult Starry Wisdom that behind many evil magic organizations in [url=https://vndb.org/c12695]Kuzaku[/url]'s world and one of the thousand forms of Outer God Nyarlathotep. In [url=https://vndb.org/v234/]Kishin Hishou[/url], he is acting as the Game Keeper that set up Game of Chaos across space and time for [url=https://vndb.org/c12695]Daijuuji Kuzaku[/url], with his opponent is [url=https://vndb.org/c12696]Another Blood[/url]. By using [url=https://vndb.org/c12696]Another Blood[/url] as the pawn and Demonbane Two-Sword as the vessel, Nyarlathotep capable of summoning the Mechanical Nightmare Deus Machina - Clockwork Phantom.[/spoiler]
